examples.text: Even though it was cloudy, there was still enough ceiling for the Blue Angels to perform a great show.

raw_glosses: (meteorology) The measurement of visible distance from ground or sea level to an overcast cloud cover; under a clear sky, the ceiling measurement is identified as "unlimited."

examples.text: The ceiling of 4.5 is 5; the ceiling of −4.5 is −4.
